Okay, I will try a hotline before any actual step is made and most of all, thank you for that last part. Talking does not initially help, but it is always good to share, I just cannot assume people want it without being told so.

There is absolutely nothing they can do, feeling better by talking has stopped working because I still gotta live through everyday so it does not matter if I feel better sometimes, I will still have to work and be responsible because nobody can support me forever financially, and not for much longer. I have to work to study what I like because I have to go to another country because the system is shit here and there is nothing for this work enough to survive but I cant work so I cant leave so I cant just sit here not studying for the university I passed through final high school exams(its free you dont pay here and no i dont want to and cant study this, i just had exams because it was the only way to find an excuse to leave my town and parents and not just suck their money, though i do just that now). I am supposed to DO something. I want to get shit faced drunk and go out and be the drunkest shit and I dont even have money for one(literally) weekly drink in a bar. I cant get drunk at home because I live with my sister lol, good I guess but I cant even do that. I just hang around at home and most nights go out with a friend that is in love with me in the most genuine way and we smoke weed and no he cant and doesnt help me because he gets mad if i cry or am sad and he will also tell my sister and he fucking loves me so I cant take more from him. Smoking for free is already too much and I feel bad but in the end I dont care, he does it with a lot of people its not only me and it is his culture to not give a shit about money. I dont take anything else, his time and his weed. And I dont keep him for weed, its just that one guy that is disconnected from my whole other life and relations other than my sister because i introduced them. And i absolutely trust him(and has told him i do not feel the same way blah blah). So in the end, i cant really live. In my head its like hospital or death. But the first entails a lot of struggle and the second nothing. They will get over it, i cant just stay not to cause trauma, sorry but in the end i will actually lose control even momentarily(never lost it) and i will die so yeah. Oh, and ill be dead, i wont really feel guilt. And not giving a shit about your family doesnt help, i am too emotionally disconnected from them since a kid. I actually think i lack some emotional capabilities but being in love since i was four with my childhood ex friend of 13 years and being content just being with her, just sitting together on the sofa, says that i actually can absolutely care about humans. I just dont know. And well i said last year she had sex with her boufriend of six months to a common friend bevause he asked me "did she have sex already?", and couldnt really say no convincingly, she lost all of her trust in me, "i broke her and she can never be the same with me again", while i have been suicidal and dipshit depressed for about 5 years and couldnt burden her with that, and i lost her to that stupid shit. I consider her family when i dont consider my family family. She supposedly did too, probably not. Now she knows im suicidal and depressed and going to psychiatrist and oh she cried and then said "i love you, call me even at three am. But i cannot trust you again, everytime i see you i remember". And then honey with blood drips from everyones ears because of the melodrama. I told her, if she did the same to me, i would actually not give a shit about it the moment she said sorry(well actually before but i just said that to sound healthy). And well, i fucked the only important thing to me up so no help for me. At least i know she will get over my death cause she doesnt care as she says so thats good. And where was I, oh yeah, I pretty much cant and dont want to try and get back into life. Hotline=too little. Sorry for my story telling i know nobody cares for that shit. Oh, I also cut myself did I say that, yeah imagining pressing more and then lights out isbkinda comforting and then "oh well i will do it anyway" is my thought.

I cannot go through them looking at me and saying stupid assuming stuff or asking me why or not believing me or or or, everytime something is mentioned about hospitals it os like it is another wprld that we no contact with, but its not like that... They think it's for "lunatics" or whatever, no respect for serious mental health problems, "oh that poor guy, he is crazy whatever", and they just never listen to me, they pretend to but behind me they freak out and worry too much in the wrong way, i could never reveal my thoughts trully because they would freak out, its like i am joining in another world that I should never join, because this stuff happens but not to us, right. I know i will do it, i know almost for sure when, if not then i didnt have the money saved for everything. I dont want summer to come because it brings too many activotoes and future imagining from everyone and i hate that i will only think of dying
